source_checks.name: Shared wire protocol byte parity
source_checks.evidence: Direct SHA256 equality of HIS integration_protocol.py and LabClear carebalance_protocol.py

source_checks.name: Explicit disabled defaults and dedicated transport
source_checks.evidence: Exact true enable flags and >=32-byte server keys required; HIS sender allows explicit loopback IP/http origins only, no URL credentials/query/fragment, proxy inheritance or followed redirect; receiver rejects browser cookies/Origin/Sec-Fetch/query

source_checks.name: HMAC integrity and bounded context
source_checks.evidence: Version, method, path, canonical timestamp, nonce, audience and raw body SHA256 are signed; constant-time comparison; duplicate auth headers rejected; explicit UTC Z wire timestamp and now < expiry <= now+120 required

source_checks.name: Nonce and business transaction separation
source_checks.evidence: Insert-only deterministic UNIQUE primary key commits before business action, including action failure; permanent retention; SQLite serialization and concurrent replay test produce one winner. Existing PostgreSQL mutex branch inspected but not executed.

source_checks.name: Source, owner and revision isolation
source_checks.evidence: Owner partition includes organization/facility/actor/patient. Exact binding additionally checks encounter/task/audience/purpose/binding/source and exact immutable cells. Report and source use dedicated entity kinds; foreign context and changed source cells fail.

source_checks.name: Human confirmation and semantic idempotency
source_checks.evidence: Explicit same-person confirmation, current source revision/hash, complete ordered source-index mapping and draft-only immutable confirmation. Atomic business writes/idempotency exclude only refreshable context expiry; same operation payload replays original receipt and changed payload conflicts.

source_checks.name: Size, schema and returned receipt checks
source_checks.evidence: Receiver streams <=256KiB before JSON validation; sender bounds request256KiB and receipt2MiB. Root/nested strict models reject extras/coercion, lab rows max60, printed Unicode strings/ranges preserved. Typed receipt validates required cell/review data, source/report/snapshot hashes, row IDs, human reviewer and confirmation hash; draft cells equal normalized source; confirmed cells equal submitted normalized reviewed cells. Deep JSON parse recursion is normalized to unknown outcome.
